name: ads-transparency-scraper
title: Google Ads Transparency Center Scraper: Ad Library
description: Returns ads from Google Ads Transparency Center (Google's ad library) by brand, domain or advertiser ID: ad copy (OCR), format, media, regions, first/last shown. No login. Example: searchQueries=["Shopify"]. Pay per event: $0.002 per ad, $0.003 per ad copy, $0.003 per advertiser.
